module: Geometry library of the editor's spline editing tools (roads, rails, fences, buildings): Catmull-Rom spline interpolation (free, raycast, terrain-conforming, with banking), Frenet frame, arc-length sampling, 2D polygon geometry (point in ring, clipping to a box, beveled offset/inset, ear clipping triangulation with holes), intersections, distances, mouse hover, spline cutting/joining and terrain utilities. A "spline" is a table with nodes, widths, nmls (input) and divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap (computed outputs).
notes: Internal constants: minimum division 10 per segment, maximum spacing 20 m between division points (hard cap 2000), polygon end margin 10 m, mouse-node tolerance 2 m, maximum banking 15 degrees, banking setting 500, cut gap 2 m.
The "2D" functions take {x, y} points (tables with x and y are enough, not necessarily vec3); the scalar functions (cross2, dot2, distSqPointSeg2D...) avoid any allocation for hot loops.
Tricky argument order: perpDistPointSeg2D takes the segment (ax, ay, bx, by) first then the point (px, py), the reverse of distSqPointSeg2D.
The module uses kdtreebox2d and editor/toolUtilities/util; some functions call editor APIs (getCameraMouseRay, core_terrain).

getPreRotQuats.desc: Returns the table of pre-rotation quaternions indexed from 0 to 3 (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees around Z).

getBarScale.desc: Returns the scale factor of the speed bars (height = barScale * speed, 0.5).

closestPointOnPolyline.desc: Closest point to p on a 3D polyline. Writes the result into outPos and returns the squared distance.

squaredDistance2D.desc: Squared distance in XY between two points (Z ignored).

smoothNodesHeightSteffen.desc: End-to-end height smoothing: fixes z[1] and z[n] and rewrites the interior Zs by Steffen interpolation along the XY length. No effect (returns false) below 3 nodes.

returns.desc: true if the smoothing was done.

closestPointOnPolyline2D.desc: Closest point to p on a polyline, measured in XY (Z interpolated). Writes into outPos and returns the squared distance.

ribbonOverlapEnd2D.desc: Where two ribbons (roads) leaving the same junction stop overlapping, in arc length along A from the center (hx, hy). Returns maxM if no usable ribbon.

aFromStart.desc: A starts from its first point.

bFromStart.desc: B starts from its first point.

squaredSegSegDist.desc: Squared distance between two 3D segments; writes the closest points into outP1 and outP2.

isMouseOverNode.desc: Tests whether the mouse hovers a node of one of the splines (tolerance 2 m). Each spline must have a nodes array.

isMouseOverPolyline.desc: Tests whether the mouse hovers a polyline; closed also tests the edge from the last node to the first.

isMouseOverBar.desc: Tests whether the mouse hovers a bar (splines with an ordered barPoints array).

isMouseOverGraphNode.desc: Tests whether the mouse hovers a node of the navigation graph.

getAABB.desc: Axis-aligned bounding box (XY) of an array of points.

polygonOBB.desc: Oriented bounding box of a 2D polygon by PCA. The points are pairs [1]=x, [2]=y.

returns.desc: Angle theta of the principal axis (rad).

computeSplinePolygon.desc: Computes a polygonal outline around a spline (left and right edges at the half-width + margin, extended by 10 m at both ends). Fast to process by scanline spans. Fills the polygon array.

spline.desc: Spline with divPoints, tangents, binormals, divWidths.

polygon.desc: Output array, cleared then filled with vec3.

isPointInTriangle.desc: Tests whether p is in the triangle (a, b, c) (barycentric coordinates).

getTerrainNormal.desc: Terrain normal at the given world point.

getTerrainNormalInPlace.desc: Terrain normal at the given world point, written into out.

rotateVecAroundZ.desc: Rotates vector v around the Z axis by the given angle, in place (the function receives vec as destination).

rotateVecAroundAxis.desc: Rotates vector v around the unit axis k by the angle theta (Rodrigues formula).

rotateVecAroundAxisInlined.desc: Like rotateVecAroundAxis without allocation: out = v*cos + (k x v)*sin + k*(k.v)*(1-cos).

computeTurningRadius.desc: Radius of curvature approximated by 3 consecutive points (average of the lengths of the two sides divided by tan(angle/2)).

isLineSegIntersect.desc: Tests whether segment (a, b) crosses segment (c, d).

intersection2LineSegs.desc: Intersection point of two segments (inline). Returns nil without an intersection.

pointsSame2D.desc: Are two points coincident in XY within eps (per component).

pointsCompare2D.desc: Comparison of two points in XY, for sorting (-1 or 1, first by x then by y).

returns.desc: -1 if a is before b, otherwise 1.

pointAboveOrOnLine2D.desc: Is the point above or on the line left->right (cross product >= -eps).

pointsCollinear2D.desc: Are three points aligned in XY (|cross product| < eps).

pointBetween2D.desc: For a p assumed aligned with left->right: false if it is an endpoint or outside. Tested on the dot product (unit m^2) and not on the normalized position, so as not to split a segment at its own endpoint (which would give a zero-length piece).

linesIntersect2D.desc: Intersection of two lines a0-a1 and b0-b1. Returns nil if parallel.

returns.desc: { pt = {x, y}, alongA, alongB } (Martinez along codes).

lineDirsHitT2D.desc: Parameter t along p0 + t*d0 at the intersection point with p1 + u*d1; nil if parallel. With d0 unit, t is in meters.

sampleCubicBezier2D.desc: Samples a cubic Bezier in XY (endpoints included).

reshapeLeadInBezier2D.desc: Reshapes in place ONE end of a node polyline (x/y, z unchanged) according to a lead-in Bezier toward a goal point, over a length L.

fromStart.desc: true: the start is the moving end.

insetPathAlongNormal2D.desc: Offsets a 2D path toward the center (cx, cy) by insetM along the local normal (inferred from code).

offsetPathMiter2D.desc: Parallel offset with mitered corners of an OPEN 2D polyline: one output point per vertex (paired rails stay aligned), z kept. Corners keep the true perpendicular width. The side is chosen ONCE for the whole path: away from (cx, cy), or toward it if inward.

offsetPathFromCenter2D.desc: Offsets a 2D polyline away from (cx, cy) along its local normal per vertex.

multiPolygonCentroidXY.desc: Area-weighted centroid of one or more closed 2D rings ({x, y}). Returns cx, cy or nil.

polylineCumLength2D.desc: 2D (XY only) cousin of polylineCumLength3D for plain {x, y} points: out[i] = distance from pts[1] to pts[i]. A reusable out array avoids allocations.

sigMoved.desc: Has a shape signature (flat list of numbers and strings) moved since old: numbers by more than tolM, strings as soon as they differ.

simplifyRDP.desc: Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplification of a polyline (perpendicular distance measured in 3D).

chordify.desc: Reduces a tessellated curve to chords of about chord meters; flagged points (flags) are always kept, as are the ends.

weldShortSegments.desc: Welds in place consecutive nodes that are almost coincident (segments shorter than minLen).

returns.desc: Number of kept nodes (inferred from code).

densifyByMaxSpacing.desc: Densifies a polyline so that no segment exceeds maxSpacing.

resampleUniformNodesWidths.desc: Resamples a polyline (nodes and widths) at a regular step.

returns.desc: New nodes (the corresponding widths are also produced, inferred from code).

smoothClosedPolygonChaikin.desc: Chaikin corner cutting of a closed polygon of {x, y} points.

distSqPointSeg2D.desc: Squared distance from the point (px, py) to the FINITE segment AB (t clamped to the segment). For frequent proximity tests.

segCrossParam2D.desc: Strict crossing of two open segments AB and CD: returns the parameter t on AB in (0,1), otherwise nil (parallel or crossing at an endpoint). Endpoints are excluded so that two strips that touch are not read as a fold.

pointInRing2D.desc: Point in a 2D polygon (ray casting, even-odd), independent of the ring's direction. The vertices are {x, y}.

clipRingRect2D.desc: Clips a ring to the box x0..x1, y0..y1. A concave ring comes back as a single ring that runs along the edge of the box between its pieces, which covers the same area in the box.

returns.desc: Clipped ring (may have fewer than 3 points).

pointInTri2D.desc: Point in a 2D triangle (barycentric), in scalars for tight loops like ear clipping.

triangulatePolygon2D.desc: Ear clipping triangulation of a simple 2D polygon (ring of {x, y}, either direction). The closing repeat is removed beforehand: a zero-length edge would block the clipping and cause the whole cap to be discarded.

returns.desc: Triplets of indices into the open ring (empty list on failure).

ringSignedArea2.desc: Twice the signed area of a 2D ring of {x, y}; positive = counter-clockwise (x to the right, y up).

bridgeHoles2D.desc: Merges hole rings into the outer ring by bridge edges. count caps the number of holes taken.

holes.desc: Holes (set back to clockwise, bridges by increasing min-x).

triangulateWithHoles2D.desc: Triangulates a possibly holed 2D polygon. If ear clipping fails with a bridging ring, drops the holes one by one rather than losing the whole cap.

returns.desc: Ring to which the triangles refer.

outsetClosedRing2D.desc: Pushes a closed ring OUTWARD by a small distance, mitered corners.

outsetRingSides2D.desc: Like outsetClosedRing2D but only for the sides designated by move[i]; the others stay exactly on their line. A vertex between a moving side and a fixed side slides along the fixed side: no notch, vertex count unchanged.

insetClosedRing2D.desc: Shrinks a closed polygon of {x, y} inward by at most dist, along the average normal of the edges of each vertex (true local inward direction, correct for concave rings).

splitPolylineByBlocked.desc: Cuts a 2D polyline into stretches that stay outside a blocked region.

minKeepM.desc: Minimum length of a kept stretch (inferred from code).

polylineZAtArcFromTip.desc: Z of the first sample at arc distance dist from the start or end tip.

tipOutwardXY.desc: Outward unit XY direction beyond an end (away from the polyline). Walks minWalkM along the chain so that a short folded-back first segment does not reverse the aim.

angleBetweenVecsNorm.desc: Small angle between two unit vectors (rad).

angleBetweenVecs.desc: Small angle between two vectors of arbitrary length (rad).

signedAngleBetweenVecs.desc: Signed angle between two vectors around an axis, assuming the vectors are in the plane of rotation.

signedAngleAroundAxis.desc: Signed angle between two vectors around an axis, after projection onto the plane of rotation. Returned in DEGREES (unlike signedAngleBetweenVecs).

quadUV.desc: Inverse bilinear in the XY plane: the (u, v) such that p = lerp(lerp(q1, q2, u), lerp(q3, q4, u), v), or nil if p is outside the quad. u runs from q1 toward q2, v from q1 toward q3.

intersectsUpQuadBarycentric.desc: Intersects a point (x, y) with a quad and returns the interpolated height there, or false if outside the quad.

pointInQuadBarycentric.desc: Determines whether a point is in a quad (in XY).

computeSourcesAABB.desc: Bounding box (XY) of the given sources.

sources.desc: Sources (points or splines, inferred from code).

getAllQuadrilaterals.desc: Builds the quadrilaterals of the sources, with lateral inflation (without longitudinal stretching).

populateTreeQuads.desc: Creates and fills a kd-tree containing the given quads.

splitSplineGeometry.desc: Cuts a spline geometry at the given node index (the two halves are moved 2 m apart at the cut point). corners (optional) is an array of per-node overrides, kept so that the engineering tools keep their per-turn radii.

corners.desc: Turn overrides aligned with the nodes.

splitLoopSplineGeometry.desc: Cuts a looped spline at the given index and returns the reordered geometry. corners is returned as the 4th value.

joinSplineGeometry.desc: Joins two spline geometries at the given node indices. Returns nil if the indices are invalid.

flipSplineDirection.desc: Reverses the direction of a spline in place (nodes, normals, corners) and marks spline.isDirty.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

closestRibbonSegPointToPoint.desc: Closest point, on a given ribbon segment, to a given point.

getNodeSpansInsidePolygon.desc: Given a polyline and a polygon, returns the runs of consecutive indices that are in the polygon.

projectPointToSpline.desc: Projects a point onto a spline. Returns nil if outside the segment bounds.

sampleSpline.desc: Samples a polyline at true arc length to compute positions and Frenet frame at regular intervals. No effect if spacing is not > 0.

sampleSplineEvenFit.desc: Sampler with adjusted distribution for discrete objects (lamp posts, bollards): the step is adjusted so that the total length is a whole number of intervals.

ribbonUpFromAlong.desc: Up vector of the road ribbon for a unit along direction: up perpendicular to along, roll taken from upRef. prevAcross keeps the lateral sign continuous along a series of placements.

ribbonIntervalFrame.desc: Mid-interval frame for rigid kit panels on a sloped or banked edge (fences, guardrails).

sampleSplineAdaptive.desc: Adaptive sampling along a spline: computes positions, Frenet frame and scales per meshLength step; the scale (minimum 0.01) depends on the curvature (sensitivity kappaSensitivity = 150). No effect if meshLength is not > 0.

translateSpline.desc: Translates a polyline by t meters along the binormal (lateral direction).

curvatureToBankAngle.desc: Converts a curvature into a banking angle (rad). maxDeg (cap on the tightest turns, default 15) and tuning (curvature at which the cap is reached, default 500) are optional overrides.

applyBankFraction.desc: Rolls the frame per station of a spline according to a READY-MADE banking fraction (bankT[i] in [-1, 1], + = left curve), peakRad being the angle reached by a full-amplitude station. The caller handles the curvature -> fraction mapping and the arc-length blending (otherwise the banking becomes a square wave).

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

computeRandomJitterQuat_ZOnly.desc: Random variation quaternion around Z only.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

computeRandomJitterQuatFromFreedomAxes.desc: Random variation quaternion based on the joint's freedom axes.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

updateRibPointsFree.desc: Recomputes the rib points of a spline in free 3D. No effect below 2 nodes.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

updateRibPointsRaycast.desc: Recomputes the rib points of a spline by vertical raycast to the nearest surface below. No effect below 2 nodes.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

updateBarPoints.desc: Updates the speed bar points of a spline; fills spline.vels and spline.velLimits.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

isBarsLimits.desc: Bars for speed limits (true) or speeds (false).

updateBarPointsGraph.desc: Updates the bar points for a navigation graph path; fills spline.vels and spline.velLimits.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

isBarsLimit.desc: Use velLimits (true) or vels (false) for the bar height.

getScanlineSpans.desc: Computes the scanline spans of a polygon on the Y axis, in terrain grid space. Stores the results in spansXMin, spansXMax and spansY.

computeSDF.desc: Computes the signed distance field (SDF) of a mask (2D array, 0 = inside).

catmullRomCentripetalFast.desc: Fast, allocation-free version of catmullRomCentripetal. If outVec is provided, writes into it and returns it; otherwise creates a vec3.

isMouseOverSpline.desc: Tests whether the mouse hovers the spline (to insert a node or hover). Uses the closest camera-ray / axis approach, so elevated roads work. maxDistSq: squared tolerance (math.huge to get the closest point unconditionally).

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

catmullRomNodesOnly.desc: Interpolates the given points with Catmull-Rom.

catmullRomNodesWidthsOnly.desc: Interpolates points and widths with Catmull-Rom (a single array of nodes).

catmullRomNodesWidthsVelVelLimits.desc: Interpolates points, widths, speeds and speed limits of a spline with Catmull-Rom (a single array of nodes).

spline.desc: Spline with nodes, widths, vels, velLimits.

computeFrenetFrame.desc: Computes the local Frenet frame at each division point (tangents, binormals, normals). Zero-length segments must not be normalized (otherwise NaN binormals and infinite DecalRoad nodes).

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

catmullRomRaycast.desc: Interpolates the nodes and widths of a spline with standard Catmull-Rom to produce its secondary geometry; points are placed by raycast onto the surface below. The data is stored in the spline (divPoints, divWidths, normals, discMap).

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

minNumDivIn.desc: Minimum number of divisions per segment (default 10).

catmullRomConformToTerrain.desc: Like catmullRomRaycast but the points are conformed to the terrain. Falls back to catmullRomRaycast if there is no terrain block.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

catmullRomFree.desc: Interpolates nodes and widths with standard Catmull-Rom (centripetal XY; Z by Steffen for a ground road, smooth Catmull-Rom for an elevated deck if deckZ). The data is stored in the spline.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

deckZ.desc: Elevated deck: Z smoothed by Catmull-Rom.

catmullRomFreeWithBanking.desc: Like catmullRomFree with automatic banking and blending.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

computeGraphPathFromNodes.desc: Computes the graph path from the nodes and fills the spline geometry (divPoints, divWidths, normals). No effect if there are not enough nodes.

spline.desc: Spline (nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, normals, tangents, binormals, discMap, isLoop...).

perpDistPointSeg2D.desc: Perpendicular distance from the point (px, py) to the segment (ax, ay)->(bx, by) in XY. Degenerate segment: distance to A. Mind the argument order: the segment points first.

cross2.desc: 2D scalar cross product of (ax, ay) and (bx, by), on plain components (without allocating a vec3 or a table).

cornerAxis.desc: Direction taken by a post, pillar or bollard PLACED ON A CORNER, from the entry and exit direction: the axis is rotated by half the turn reduced modulo period (default pi/2). Ties go to the smaller turn so that left and right corners mirror each other.

period.desc: Symmetry period of the post (rad, default pi/2).

lineIntersect2D.desc: Intersection of two INFINITE lines P+s*D and Q+s*E; returns ix, iy or nil if parallel.

rayIntersect2D.desc: Intersection of two RAYS (forward only) P+s*D and Q+u*E; returns ix, iy or nil (parallel or point behind one of the rays).
